title: Employee Transfer
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, characters celebrate Halloween, discuss personal relationships, and face changes such as Holly's transfer to Nashua. The episode features pranks, relationship doubts, and plans for future trips, highlighting the characters' camaraderie and individual ambitions amid the backdrop of Holly's impending move.
